Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 0D <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
No identity check: the data list prints the identity reply with the family bytes as `dd dd`, a code for each model.

Parameter changes at 40-42 (Normal Voice) and 46-47 (Drum Voice) edit the voice in the Voice mode's edit buffer; Pull asks for each edit buffer the Bulk Control table names, whichever mode the instrument is in. The data list says an edit buffer is sent only in its own mode, so the requests for the others go unanswered; each is asked once.
